get.description: Stream step, run and activity changes as server-sent events until the run finishes.

200.description: Server-sent events. `event: run` carries a RunOut without steps (first, on every run state or cost change, and last once the run is `done` or `failed`); `event: step` carries a StepOut (every step once, then each change); `event: activity` carries an ActivityOut with `id: <seq>` (the backlog after `Last-Event-ID` or `?after=`, then a `: live` comment, then each new one). Once the run is finished and every activity has been sent, `event: end` (data `{}`) is the last frame: clients close on it, not on a finished `run`, which a reconnect sends before the backlog. Other lines starting with `:` are keepalives.
